fix(layer): ship the native addon versions dd-trace declares (#857)

The layer is installed with --ignore-optional, which drops dd-trace's
optional native addons (@datadog/pprof, @datadog/native-appsec). The build
re-added them at our own devDependency pins, which drift from the versions
dd-trace calls into:

- dd-trace >= 5.128.0 / 6.17.0 defaults
  DD_PROFILING_EXPERIMENTAL_OOM_HEAP_LIMIT_EXTENSION_SIZE to "auto", which
  only @datadog/pprof >= 5.19.0 accepts. Against our 5.18.1 pin the
  profiler fails to start ("Heap limit extension size must be a uint32")
  and no profiles are sent. Released layers still ship dd-trace 6.15.0 and
  are not affected yet; a layer built against dd-trace master is.
- @datadog/native-appsec "*" resolves to 11.0.1 from the lockfile, while
  dd-trace 6.15.0 declares 11.0.2.

Take both from the installed dd-trace's optionalDependencies instead, and
do the same in the local integration test layer fixture.
